text:
Riley Chen: Hey folks — quick urgent question. Baby ended up back in NICU, docs expect another 3-4 weeks there. I'm currently on parental leave (ends May 5). How do I extend? Also worried about the mid-cycle performance review and the laptop the company requested we return.

Michelle (People Ops): So sorry to hear that, Riley. Sending support. :heart: Steps: 1) File an amendment to your existing leave in the HR portal (choose "extend existing parental leave"). 2) Upload updated physician note (NICU discharge estimate). 3) If you qualify for FMLA, we can retroactively extend job protection — we'll start the FMLA packet when you submit. Can you submit by tomorrow to avoid payroll cutover?

Riley Chen: Thanks Michelle. I can get the note today. If I extend, will benefits (health, 401k deferral) stay active? Also what about pay top-up?

benefits-bot: Eligibility lookup: Parental leave top-up applies if tenure >= 6 months. Health plan continuation: automatic if you remain an active leave participant. 401(k): employer match pauses during unpaid portions. Link: https://handbook.internal/leaves#top-up

Sam (People Ops): Quick payroll note: We can apply Redwood top-up for paid leave weeks automatically if you elected supplemental pay when you first filed. If this becomes unpaid, payroll will prorate and Sam will follow up DM to set up any retro checks. Please confirm whether you want to elect supplemental pay for the extension.

Riley Chen: I did elect supplemental pay initially. I'll reconfirm in DM.

Anya Patel: Riley — for the review, we can pause your performance review and shift calibration. Options: A) Defer review until return + note in calibration B) Manager completes a limited "check-in" that excludes promotion/compensation decisions. Which do you prefer?

Riley Chen: Prefer defer until return. Would like to avoid compensation impact while out.

Michelle (People Ops): Defer is fine; please add a one-sentence note in the review form citing approved parental extension. HR will annotate calibration docs to exclude promotion/raise actions during leave.

Diego Ramos: I can pick up Riley's oncall and urgent pager items while they're out. @Anya, I'll need access to the debug keys and the staging creds — tagging infra team separately.

Riley Chen: Diego huge thanks. Two quick ops asks: 1) The laptop — org asked I return it last week; can I keep it while child is inpatient? 2) Are we able to get a temporary device for the caretaker?

Sam (People Ops): Laptop policy: If you're on extended leave for a medical family reason, we can authorize short-term device retention. Submit a ticket to IT with subject "Leave device retention - Riley Chen" and copy me. For caretaker device, we don't typically provision new devices for non-employees; however we can provide temporary hotspot or VPN token. If you need an exception, include justification in the IT ticket.

Riley Chen: Will submit IT ticket. Thanks.

Michelle (People Ops): Timeline recap:
- Today (by EOD): Riley uploads updated physician note and files leave amendment in HR portal
- Tomorrow: Sam starts payroll/FMLA packet and confirms top-up
- Within 48h: HR annotates performance review status as "deferred"
- Within 72h: Manager assigns Diego as interim oncall and posts updated rota

Riley Chen: One more: childcare subsidy I applied for starts June 1. Will extension affect eligibility?

benefits-bot: Childcare subsidy eligibility: active employee status required at start date. If leave is fully paid/top-up continues and benefits stay active, subsidy starts as scheduled. If unpaid portion extends past subsidy start, re-check needed. Link: https://handbook.internal/benefits/childcare

Anya Patel: If there's a gap, we can backstop with manager-approved exception for 30 days; please notify me and Michelle ASAP.

Diego Ramos: I posted a stub playbook in #eng-oncall with initial runbook links and assigned escalations. Will follow up with infra for keys.

Riley Chen: Thank you everyone. Really appreciate the quick responses and support. I'll upload the note and file the amendment now.

Sam (People Ops): Sending a DM with the payroll checklist and IT ticket template. If anything urgent pops up tag @People-Ops and we'll triage.
